title: Procurement Failure Modes: Buyer Decision Mapping & Scout Ops Playbook
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Define a concise playbook that maps enterprise procurement failure modes (what makes buyers switch or pause procurement) to observable signals and an operational scouting response. Deliverables: 1) failure-mode taxonomy (decision drivers, timing, evidence), 2) prioritized signal set and telemetry mapping, 3) lightweight scout-runbook for PM/GTM/Sales with play examples, 4) scoring rubric for model substitution risk and suggested mitigation actions.
acceptance_criteria: Taxonomy covers at least 6 distinct buyer failure modes with examples (e.g., latency spike, pricing shock, regulatory flag, model drift, contract cadence, feature regression)
Signal mapping ties each failure mode to >=2 measurable telemetry sources (console metrics, logs, usage patterns, customer tickets)
Scout runbook includes templated outreach scripts, probing prompts, and quick lab checklist for engineering validation
Scoring rubric validated by at least 2 sales/customer-success reps and 1 reliability engineer
Playbook and artifacts stored in Confluence and linked into signal-hub ingestion as a new watchlist
tasks: Interview 8 enterprise buyers / procurement contacts to capture decision heuristics
Audit existing telemetry for candidate signals (latency percentiles, embed failure rate, token price deltas)
Prototype substitution-risk score in spreadsheet and backfill with 3 public case studies
Draft scout-runbook and circulate to SRE and Sales for feedback
Create Confluence doc and attach sample alert mappings for signal-hub
